This can be achieved by lowering the temperature of the container or by allowing the container to expand into a larger volume. Doing so will result in fewer collisions between the gas molecules, thus decreasing their kinetic energy and the temperature of the gas. Ice also works as an effective cooling agent as it can absorb a great deal of heat energy before it melts.
